messages:
Eve (Product): quick thread — need final decision on onboarding pin policy for next catalog wave. options: default soft-pin 60d or 120d, or paid locked-pin. pick one.
Jon (Eng): prefer 60d soft-pin. easier ops and less routing churn.
Rhea (Infra): 60d is safer. will add rate-limit: max_unpins_per_region=40/day and cooldown per-model=1h.
Ava (CS): customers want visibility. we must send T-30/T-7/T-1 emails and in-console banner. sales flagged a few enterprise deals that require locked-pin for 180d.
Eve (Product): decision: default 60d soft-pin, retention-paid add-ons for 180/365 via sales. locked-pin reserved for contract cases.
Jon (Eng): implementation notes: need pin metadata (pinned_by, pin_type, expiry_ts) + status enum. background sweeper with dry-run flag.
Rhea (Infra): will implement sweeper + metrics: pinned_total, auto_unpinned, unpin_errors, route_switch_p95. also adding warmup hook to prefetch KV to reduce cold latency.
Ava (CS): i'll prepare comms template and list of enterprise tenants to exclude from auto-unpin.
Eve (Product): launch criteria: audit trail, notif cadence, sweeper rate-limits, route_switch_p95 < 150ms canary. if not met, fallback to sticky-route for 24h.
ops-bot: reminder set for 4123530000 "pin-policy docs review" :bell:
Jon (Eng): will run small canary (10 tenants) after warmup hook. report back with bench numbers.
Eve (Product): thanks — confirm if action owners above. keep replies to confirmations only. :thumbsup:
